name: @unitpost/sdk-php
description: Workspace shim for the PHP SDK (published to Packagist as unitpost/unitpost).

scripts.test: if command -v php >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -f vendor/bin/phpunit ]; then php vendor/bin/phpunit --colors=never; else echo 'skip: php or vendor/bin/phpunit not available (composer install runs in the dedicated sdks CI job)'; fi
scripts.build: echo 'php sdk: composer package, built in publish-sdk-php.yml'
